item.title: OpenAI Countersues Apple Over Trade Secret Theft and Supplier Coercion
item.description:
OpenAI has countersued Apple in a California court, alleging trade secret theft, coercion of shared suppliers and abuse of market power to stifle competition. The filing answers Apple's summer lawsuit over poached employees leaking confidential data, escalating a legal battle spanning talent and supply chains.

原文标题：OpenAI 反诉苹果窃取商业机密并胁迫共同供应商

Why it matters：两大科技巨头围绕商业机密与供应链的诉讼战升级，牵动 AI 硬件合作与人才流动格局。

item.title: Michael Nielsen Takes Down His Classic Neural Networks Book
item.description:
Michael Nielsen announced that he has taken down his classic online textbook Neural Networks and Deep Learning, with the original site no longer accessible. The book, which systematically covered backpropagation and deep learning fundamentals, was a widely used entry point for practitioners; no reason for the removal was given.

原文标题：Michael Nielsen 下架其经典神经网络教材

Why it matters：知名深度学习教材突然下架，影响大量学习者的参考资料获取。

item.title: OpenAI Model Produces 730 Math Manuscripts on Open Problems
item.description:
OpenAI has released a repository of mathematical manuscripts generated by an unnamed internal model, comprising 730 manuscripts across 375 families tackling open research problems, with some results backed by Lean formalizations. OpenAI frames the material as raw research data rather than polished papers, warns that unformalized results may contain errors, and pledges to keep adding Lean proofs.

原文标题：OpenAI 模型产出 730 篇数学手稿

Why it matters：这是大模型直接冲击数学研究前沿的规模化证据，且公开了验证状态与局限，值得关注。

item.title: Banned Nvidia Blackwell Chips Found in Shanghai Data Center
item.description:
Bloomberg, citing Chinese regulatory filings, reports that two Shanghai companies deployed US-export-banned Nvidia GB300-NVL72 and GB200 servers at a Shanghai data center and pledged them as loan collateral. A serial number in a public warranty database traced the GB300 rack to Taiwanese manufacturer Gigabyte, and the firms are closely tied to Singapore-based Megaspeed, underscoring how restricted AI compute keeps reaching China without US licenses.

原文标题：禁售 Nvidia Blackwell 芯片现身上海数据中心

Why it matters：出口管制下的顶级 AI 算力实际流向再获文件级证据，直接关系算力供给与合规风险。

item.title: Convex Ships Official Claude Code Plugin for Backend Development
item.description:
Convex released an official Claude Code plugin bundling a backend design skill, a live-scaffolding quickstart skill, the convex-expert subagent, a runtime error monitor and the Convex MCP server in a single install. Once installed, Claude automatically routes backend requests toward Convex idioms such as @convex-dev/agent, Convex Auth, reactive queries and the workflow component instead of generic patterns.

原文标题：Convex 发布 Claude Code 官方插件 一键接入后端开发

Why it matters：这是把后端平台能力封装进编码智能体工作流的典型插件化实践，对使用 Claude Code 的开发者有直接可用价值。

item.title: Meta and AMI Labs Studies Back LeCun's JEPA World Model Bet
item.description:
After leaving Meta, Yann LeCun co-founded Paris-based AMI Labs and raised over $1 billion to pursue JEPA world models instead of large language models. Three new studies from Meta and AMI Labs show how the architecture's components fit together, while physics remains a limiting factor.

原文标题：Meta 与 AMI Labs 三项研究力挺 LeCun 世界模型路线

Why it matters：这是 LeCun 路线与主流大模型路线之争的关键实证进展，涉及超 10 亿美元融资与三项具体研究。

item.title: OpenAI Builds Athena Data Platform to Reduce AI Agent Guesswork
item.description:
OpenAI is developing a data management platform codenamed Athena that works like a semantic layer, giving consistent definitions for business metrics such as revenue and customer count so agents guess less when handling enterprise data. The platform is still in early development, and at least one customer reportedly found ChatGPT Work's data analysis agent insufficiently accurate. Athena is also meant to let agents collect, document and update business rules, creating a switching cost that is harder to overcome than swapping models.

原文标题：OpenAI 研发 Athena 数据平台 降低智能体猜测误差

Why it matters：OpenAI 从模型层向数据语义层延伸，直接关系智能体在企业场景的可靠性，值得关注。

item.title: AI Coding Agents Speed Up Unofficial GTA 6 PC Port After Leak
item.description:
Days after GTA 6's record console launch, a leaked Xbox build has been distributed and multiple developer projects are using AI coding agents to accelerate reverse engineering for an unofficial PC port. Some builds already boot the game and show early multiplayer features, pressuring Rockstar's staggered release model while legal action against decentralized groups proves largely ineffective.

原文标题：GTA 6 泄露版遭 AI 编码代理逆向移植 PC

Why it matters：AI 编码代理被用于大规模逆向工程，直接冲击头部游戏厂商的分阶段发售商业模型，是 AI 工具改变产业规则的典型案例。

item.title: Formal Proof Checkers Hit by Multiple Soundness Bugs
item.description:
Cryptographer D. J. Bernstein has compiled reports of soundness bugs in major computer proof checkers such as Coq and Rocq, far outnumbering earlier tallies by Paulson and Stérin. The flaws could let false statements pass formal verification, undermining trust in AI-assisted theorem proving and formal methods.

原文标题：形式化证明检查器被曝多起可靠性漏洞

Why it matters：系统梳理形式化证明检查器的可靠性漏洞，对依赖机器验证的 AI 数学与安全关键系统具有直接警示价值。

item.title: GPT 6.2 Astra Cracks a Historical Mystery
item.description:
The piece uses GPT 6.2 Astra's resolution of a historical mystery as a hook to argue that AI progress in mathematics and related fields is accelerating far faster than expected, citing recent events such as the claimed Navier-Stokes breakthrough and new results from an Anthropic mathematician. However, the middle of the source is truncated, leaving key methods and verification details missing and the evidence strength limited.

原文标题：GPT 6.2 Astra 破解一桩历史悬案

Why it matters：涉及前沿模型能力跃迁与数学突破的宏观判断，值得关注但原文残缺、证据不足。

item.title: SAP Plans to Cut at Least 10,000 Jobs in AI Pivot
item.description:
SAP is preparing to eliminate at least 10,000 positions, roughly nine percent of its 110,000-plus global workforce, with product development, engineering and sales hit hardest. The move follows about 10,000 cuts in 2024 as CEO Christian Klein pushes to embed AI tools across SAP's product lineup. The final number is not fixed and could change after talks with employee representatives, while German staff retain a job guarantee through 2028.

原文标题：SAP 拟裁员至少 1 万人全面转向 AI

Why it matters：企业软件巨头以万人级裁员换取 AI 转型，是 AI 重塑大型科技公司组织结构的标志性事件。

item.title: Stanford Physicist Taps GPT-6 to Advance Quantum Gravity Theory
item.description:
Stanford physicist Venkatesa Chandrasekaran has proposed a quantum gravity theory that uses light paths to compute spacetime fluctuations, yielding a finite result for a graviton-pair calculation that otherwise diverges and reproducing a known quantum correction to black hole entropy. He says several calculations and proofs emerged from months of collaboration with OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, consuming roughly 400 million tokens, illustrating frontier models' substantive role in theoretical physics.

原文标题：斯坦福物理学家借助 GPT-6 提出量子引力新理论

Why it matters：这是 AI 深度参与理论物理推导的罕见具体案例，兼具科学增量与模型能力信号。

item.title: EngineAI Opens Humanoid Brain Stack with $140M Ecosystem Fund
item.description:
EngineAI used its 2026 Global Developer Conference to open its humanoid robot hardware, data and compute to ecosystem partners, backed by a RMB 1 billion industry support program with Henan Investment Group and Yuanhe Chenkun. CEO Zhao Tongyang framed 2027 as the pivot from mass production to commercialization, arguing robot makers should supply a general platform while partners contribute vertical know-how. The move marks another bid by a Chinese embodied-AI vendor to build a developer ecosystem, though API details, data volumes and fund deployment terms remain undisclosed.

原文标题：众擎开放大小脑并推 10 亿元生态支持计划

Why it matters：国内人形机器人厂商以 10 亿元资金加本体、数据、算力开放争夺开发者生态，是具身智能竞争从本体转向平台的关键信号。

item.title: Google Rolls Out AI-Generated Custom Widgets on Android
item.description:
Google has begun rolling out Create My Widget to Pixel phones, letting users generate custom home screen widgets from natural language as part of its Gemini Intelligence suite. Hands-on testing shows it handles novelty widgets well but fails at real-time data tasks like live bus arrivals, exposing the limits of AI-generated widgets without dynamic data access.

原文标题：谷歌 Android 上线 AI 生成自定义小组件

Why it matters：这是对 AI 生成小组件功能的实测体验，展示了自然语言生成 UI 的实际能力边界。

The Verge AI · tools · signal 42/100

item.title: Meituan Says WeChat AI Pilot on Track as 2027 AI Capex Set to Fall
item.description:
Meituan CEO Wang Xing confirmed on the earnings call that its local-services pilot with WeChat's AI assistant is proceeding as planned, focused on building complete service flows inside the WeChat ecosystem. He also said Meituan will keep AI spending ROI-driven, with next year's AI capex expected to fall below this year's level as efficiency gains gradually offset new investment.

原文标题：美团与微信小微合作推进 明年 AI 资本开支将低于今年

Why it matters：头部本地生活平台明确 AI 资本开支收缩与微信生态合作节奏，是观察大厂 AI 投入回报权衡的重要信号。

item.title: AgiBot Elf G2 Takes On Speaker BOX Assembly at Longcheer Production Line
item.description:
AgiBot announced that its Elf G2 humanoid robot has taken on speaker BOX installation at Longcheer's Nanchang plant, running in-line alongside its existing quality-inspection loading tasks. The company says this extends the robot from transport-type work to precision operation, with the same unit handling different processes without custom modification. An earlier live production stream reported a 99.99% task success rate in tablet quality inspection.

原文标题：智元精灵 G2 在龙旗产线承担喇叭 BOX 精密装配

Why it matters：人形机器人进入消费电子量产线的精密装配环节，是具身智能落地的重要信号，但细节以厂商口径为主。

item.title: Samsung Develops 500-Layer-Plus NAND with 50% More Capacity per Die
item.description:
Samsung has developed a 500-layer-plus NAND flash device, raising per-die capacity from 1Tb to 1.5Tb and areal density by 50%, which implies roughly a 33% cut in cost per bit if die cost holds. The part, likely its 11th-generation V11, is in trial production at Pyeongtaek lines with yields around 30%, targeting commercialization next year and an ISSCC 2027 reveal.

原文标题：三星开发出 500 层以上 NAND 单芯片容量提升 50%

Why it matters：存储层数跨代与单位成本三成的量级变化，直接影响 AI 数据中心的存储成本曲线与三星对 SK 海力士、美光的竞争位次。

item.title: Kimi Launches Science Program with Up to $20,000 in API Credits
item.description:
Moonshot AI has launched a Kimi for Science support program offering selected researchers up to $20,000 in Kimi API credits, roughly 7 billion tokens, with the exact amount set by research needs and review outcomes. The program lowers the cost barrier for research use through subsidized model access, but no specific projects, technical approaches or partner institutions were disclosed.

原文标题：Kimi 推出科研支持计划 提供最高 2 万美元 API 额度

Why it matters：这是面向科研群体的 API 额度补贴计划，对关注大模型科研落地的读者有参考价值，但缺乏技术细节。

item.title: China Unveils Rules for Interoperable Decentralized Digital IDs
item.description:
China's Cyberspace Administration and ten other departments issued rules governing decentralized digital identity registration, issuance and verification on a national blockchain-based identity chain, effective March 1, 2027. The rules cover individuals, organizations and industrial devices, encourage interoperability with digital RMB identities and agent identity labeling, and bar use of identity data for profiling or targeted marketing.

原文标题：十一部门发布分布式数字身份规定 2027 年施行

Why it matters：这是国家级数字身份基础设施的正式落地规则，直接涉及区块链身份链与智能体身份标识，对 AI 身份与合规生态有实质影响。

item.title: UK Completes First Cardless AI Agent Purchase with Papa John's Order
item.description:
The UK has completed its first cardless purchase made by an AI agent, with a Papa John's order placed without sharing bank security details. Conducted inside the FCA's regulated sandbox with Lloyds Bank and payments specialist TrueLayer, the trial demonstrates that agents can transact on a user's behalf.

原文标题：英国完成首笔 AI 智能体无卡支付披萨订单

Why it matters：这是智能体支付落地的首个受监管实证，对关注 AI 商业化的读者具有参考价值。

item.title: China Report Finds Nearly Half of Adults Have Basic AI Literacy
item.description:
China's Cyberspace Administration released its 2026 national digital literacy survey, which for the first time measured AI literacy: 47.46% of adult citizens have basic or higher AI literacy, while only 4.75% reach an advanced level. Overall digital literacy reached 64.69%, up 4.08 points from 2024, with persistent urban-rural and regional gaps.

原文标题：网信办首次调查显示近半数成年公民具备 AI 素养

Why it matters：官方首次给出全国 AI 素养基线数据，是观察中国 AI 普及程度与人才储备的重要宏观参照。

item.title: SenseTime Wins Top CAICT Rating for Token Factory Platform
item.description:
China's CAICT released its first tiered evaluation framework for Token factory compute capability at the Hi-Tech Fair, and SenseTime's SenseCore Token Factory became the first to earn the top Full-Stack Service Leader rating. The framework scores providers across five layers and 14 metrics spanning Token production, efficiency, delivery, operations and compliance; SenseTime cites over 99.95% monthly availability and support for 20+ domestic AI chips.

原文标题：商汤大装置获信通院 Token 工厂最高评级

Why it matters：Token 工厂首次有了权威分级标准，商汤拿下首个最高评级，是观察国产算力服务标准化的一个信号。

item.title: ByteDance's Doubao Model Powers 80% of Top TV Makers
item.description:
Volcano Engine said its Doubao large model now powers TVs from Skyworth, Changhong, Hisense and TCL, covering 80% of China's top TV makers. The stack pairs a real-time voice agent for interaction with a cloud agent for long-running tasks, replacing ASR plus small-model intent routing. Doubao-enabled TVs topped RMB 100 million in sales on Douyin e-commerce during the 2026 Double 11.

原文标题：豆包大模型接入八成头部电视厂商 双十一销售额破亿

Why it matters：大模型落地家电终端的规模化案例，附带渠道销售数据，反映端侧智能体商业化进展。

item.title: WeChat Open-Sources WeMM-Ecom Multimodal Model Family for E-Commerce
item.description:
Tencent's WeChat Vision team has open-sourced WeMM-Ecom, a multimodal foundation model family spanning four dense models (0.8B to 9B) and a 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts model, all natively supporting fast-answer and deep-thinking modes with BF16, FP8, GPTQ and GGUF weights released. Built on Qwen3.5 and the in-house WeChat-YATT training framework, the 35B-A3B variant leads hundreds-of-billions-parameter flagship models on 28 e-commerce benchmarks with a score of 74.4, while the 2B model ranks first among lightweight models across 64 public general benchmarks. The family is already deployed across hundreds of WeChat e-commerce workflows at a daily call volume in the billions, covering product catalog auto-filling, cross-store SKU matching, listing compliance review and livestream understanding.

原文标题：微信开源 WeMM-Ecom 多模态模型家族 日均调用十亿量级

Why it matters：微信首次开源面向电商场景的多模态模型家族，兼具完整权重开放与十亿级真实业务落地，是开源多模态与产业应用结合的重要节点。

item.title: 神经接口仿生手让患者重获触觉
item.description:
MIT Technology Review 报道了一项临床试验：一种直接接入手臂神经的仿生手，让截肢患者 Avi Davidson 不仅能控制手部动作，还能重新获得触觉。该试验要求参与者投入数百小时的实验室训练与康复治疗，文章重点呈现了患者本人的经历与心态。

Why it matters：神经接口仿生手进入临床试验并实现触觉反馈，是脑机与具身智能交叉领域的真实落地案例。

item.title: 谷歌第 10 代 TPU 曝光 配 512GB 定制 HBM5
item.description:
韩媒爆料称，谷歌第 10 代 TPU（代号 Quillfish）将配备 512GB 定制 HBM5 内存，由联发科承担设计服务，并有望沿用英特尔 EMIB-T 先进封装，量产时间指向 2029 年。该规格若属实，将显著抬升单芯片内存容量上限，成为观察下一代 AI ASIC 竞争的重要窗口。需注意消息来自媒体爆料，距量产尚有约三年，细节存在变数。

Why it matters：爆料揭示了谷歌下一代 TPU 的内存与封装路线，是判断 AI ASIC 竞争格局的前瞻信号。

item.title: 韩国政府要求三星开发机器人芯片对标 Jetson Thor
item.description:
韩国政府今年 10 月要求三星电子开发可与英伟达 Jetson Thor 竞争的机器人算力芯片，以推进物理 AI 算力基座国产化，但三星反应谨慎。三星面临国内市场规模有限、英伟达生态先发优势明显、系统 LSI 业务持续亏损三重制约，是否立项仍存不确定性。

Why it matters：反映物理 AI 算力国产化动向与英伟达机器人芯片主导地位面临的首个国家级挑战信号。

item.title: 小米汽车世界模型 2.0 发布 已落地合成数据与仿真
item.description:
小米汽车正式发布世界模型 2.0，将多视角视频生成、物理交互建模、三维场景重建与动作建模统一为因果世界模型，支持 1 至 7 路摄像头视角，训练语料达 1260 万段视频片段。该模型在 PAI-Bench-G 驾驶与机器人视频生成评测中分别取得 78.0 和 77.1 的最高分，闭环仿真碰撞率降至 0.4%，并已交付超 20 万 clips 合成数据用于感知模型训练。

Why it matters：世界模型统一多任务建模并已在合成数据与闭环仿真中真实落地，是自动驾驶与具身智能交叉方向的重要工程进展。

item.title: 李香凝与导演探索用 AI 复活李小龙
item.description:
李小龙之女李香凝在新加坡金狮大赏论坛透露，正与导演武贝探索用 AI 技术让李小龙重返大银幕，相关影视项目体裁与平台尚未确定。她强调必须保留人的参与，警惕纯 AIGC 生成缺乏灵魂与逐利导向，称这如同走钢丝。事件折射已故艺人 AI 数字人复出潮背后的授权与伦理争议。

item.title: 港科大与腾讯混元开源 Rosetta 破解基模灾难性遗忘
item.description:
腾讯混元多模态基模组与香港科技大学联合提出 Rosetta 组合式原生多模态预训练方法，从底层架构与优化机制上缓解基模在学习图像生成等新能力时对原有语言能力的灾难性遗忘。该工作已被 NeurIPS 2026 接收，预训练、推理、评测代码及模型权重已全面开源，支持单卡至千卡集群。

Why it matters：针对原生多模态预训练中灾难性遗忘这一核心难题给出架构级解法，且代码与权重全开源，工程与研究价值兼具。
